Generated by haruspex from IR 0.25. Do not edit.
Each procedure's results are the schema in $defs under its name, and each named type is there too.
Every value is described as SQL Server's FOR JSON writes it, a rowset's rows as an array of objects as FOR JSON PATH, INCLUDE_NULL_VALUES writes them, every column a key, null where it is null.
The notes in descriptions rest on these facts:
- A decimal's places are not given as multipleOf, which a validator reading numbers as doubles tests inexactly: 0.07 divided by 0.01 is not a whole number in binary floating point.
- Many validators read a JSON number as a double, which holds every integer up to 2^53 exactly, and keeps the digits of a decimal of up to 15 significant digits.

tabs.description: SQL type bigint. A bigint, exact only up to 2^53 in a validator that reads numbers as doubles. Its type is bigint, where cafe.tab.tab_id is int: what it is computed with makes it another type. Why: haruspex explain cafe.guest_spending tabs

spent.description: SQL type decimal(19,2). At most 2 decimal places, which multipleOf would check inexactly. decimal(19,2) has more digits than a double holds, so a validator that reads numbers as doubles checks it on the nearest doubles. May be null: arithmetic-overflow (procedures/guest_spending.sql:9:8). Its type is decimal(19,2), where cafe.tab_item.qty is smallint and cafe.menu_item.price is decimal(9,2): what it is computed with makes it another type. May be null: arithmetic that overflows or divides by zero is null when the caller's session has ANSI_WARNINGS and ARITHABORT off (arithmetic-overflow). To change it: declare the callers' ANSI_WARNINGS or ARITHABORT on in the config file's "session", or wrap it in COALESCE or ISNULL. Why: haruspex explain cafe.guest_spending spent

best_tip.description: SQL type decimal(9,2). At most 2 decimal places, which multipleOf would check inexactly. May be null: nullable-column (cafe.tab.tip), unmatched-row (procedures/guest_spending.sql:13:11). May be null: it comes from the optional side of an outer join, which has no row when nothing matches (unmatched-row). To change it: if the data rules it out, declare it in the config file with "nullable": false and why. Why: haruspex explain cafe.guest_spending best_tip
